name: What factors determine the cost of a wall tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of a wall tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wall tile installation costs depend on the tile material, project square footage, wall prep needs, and layout complexity. Basic ceramic subway tile on a flat kitchen backsplash requires less labor and materials than custom-cut marble or intricate mosaic patterns in a walk-in shower. Costs increase if the underlying wall needs framing adjustments, plumbing coordination, or water-damaged drywall replacement. Working with a hands-on general contractor who handles drywall, framing, and tile under one roof eliminates the need to pay separate trade markups for prep work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on square footage, tile type, layout complexity, and the amount of wall repair, framing adjustments, or waterproofing required before tiling.
